author: Daniele Morais
title: Tropical cyclone: alerta orange for região não especificada
seoTitle: Tropical cyclone in região não especificada: alert orange
subtitle: The global disaster alert system rates event "TWENTYNINE-26" at orange (moderate to high) level.
excerpt: Tropical cyclone puts região não especificada under orange (moderate to high) alert in the international GDACS system.
contentHtml:
GDACS, the global disaster alert and coordination system run by the UN and the European Commission, issued a orange (moderate to high) alert for event "TWENTYNINE-26" (tropical cyclone) affecting região não especificada.

From the official bulletin: From 14/10/2026 to 14/10/2026, a Tropical Depression (maximum wind speed of 231 km/h) TWENTYNINE-26 was active in NWPacific. The cyclone affects these countries: Guam (vulnerability [unknown]). Estimated population affected by category 1 (120 km/h) wind speeds or higher is 0.177 million .

What the alert level means

GDACS rates events green, orange or red based on estimated humanitarian impact — exposed population, regional vulnerability and local response capacity.

With data from GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System).
